simulateSwap(address,uint32,int256,uint1.details: These parameters are similar to ClearingHouse's swapToken function

params.amount: The amount of token to be swapped, positive for long, negative for short
params.isNotional: Whether the amount is in vQuote/dollar terms, use false for vToken
params.poolId: The poolId of the pool to be simulated on
params.sqrtPriceLimitX96: The slippage limit of the swap, use zero for unbounded slippage

simulateSwapOnVPool(address,uint24,uint2.details: These parameters are similar to IUniswapV3Pool's swap function

params.amountSpecified: Amount to be swapped, positive for exactIn and negative for exactOut
params.liquidityFeePips: The liquidity fee pips, available from poolInfo in clearingHouse
params.protocolFeePips: The protocol fee pips, available from poolInfo in clearingHouse
params.sqrtPriceLimitX96: The slippage limit of the swap, use zero for unbounded slippage
params.swapVTokenForVQuote: Whether vToken is being sold or shorted
